name: ፍርፍር
description: A traditional Ethiopian breakfast dish made with shredded injera sautéed in spiced butter and seasoned with berbere. Savory, tangy, and comforting—best enjoyed with a side of fresh injera.

name: ዶሮ ወጥ
description: A classic Ethiopian chicken stew simmered in a rich berbere spice sauce with onions, garlic, and ginger. Served with hard-boiled eggs and paired perfectly with injera. Bold, spicy, and deeply flavorful.

name: ቴስቲ ሶያ
description: Tender soy chunks sautéed with onions, peppers, and Ethiopian spices. A flavorful vegetarian twist on the classic tibs, served hot with injera.

name: ሽሮ
description: A smooth, flavorful stew made from roasted chickpea or broad bean flour, simmered with onions, garlic, and berbere. Creamy, comforting, and best enjoyed with injera.

name: ክክ
description: Split peas simmered in a bold berbere sauce with onions and garlic. Rich, spicy, and hearty—served with injera for a vibrant, flavorful classic.

name: ቋንጣ ፍርፍር
description: Shredded injera sautéed with spiced butter and berbere, mixed with strips of dried beef (quanta). Smoky, tangy, and hearty—an Ethiopian favorite best enjoyed with fresh injera.

name: ሸክላ ጥብስ
description: Succulent beef cubes sautéed with onions, peppers, and Ethiopian spices, served sizzling hot in a traditional clay pot. Smoky, spicy, and full of flavor—best enjoyed with injera.

name: በየ አይነቱ
description: A vibrant platter of assorted Ethiopian dishes—lentils, peas, greens, and stews—served together on injera. Colorful, diverse, and perfect for sharing the full taste of Ethiopia.

name: ክትፎ
description: Finely minced beef seasoned with spiced butter and mitmita chili powder. Served raw, lightly cooked, or fully sautéed—rich, buttery, and boldly flavorful, paired with injera or gomen.

name: ጠጅ
description: Tej (ተጅ) is a traditional Ethiopian honey wine fermented with wild honey and bitter-herbs (gesho), offering a smooth, golden, and uniquely sweet-yet-earthy flavor profile..

name: ጠላ
description: Tella (ጠላ): Traditional Ethiopian home-brewed beer crafted from fermented barley, wheat, or sorghum, and flavored with gesho (buckthorn) leaves. It has a cloudy appearance, a distinctly earthy, smoky, and bitter-sweet flavor, and a smooth, refreshing finish.

name: ሃበሻ ቢራ
description: Habesha Beer is a crisp and refreshing golden lager brewed in Ethiopia. Crafted with the finest malt, hops, and pure spring water, it offers a smooth, balanced taste with a subtle, pleasant bitterness and a clean finish.

name: ቡና
description: Freshly roasted and brewed in a clay jebena, this aromatic single-origin Arabica is celebrated in a rich cultural ritual. Served piping hot in traditional sini cups
